title: Draft the 5-sentence walk-in offer for a gym th… · T3-B-5

content.text:
Restart note: you reloaded every window at 13:36 AWST, so test whether the status bar follows the focused Claude tab when you switch sessions in the same workspace.

Here's the draft. It's built on the 09-18 ruling, so it offers a rebuild and not a polish of their Squarespace site. It's problem-led, with no prices and no method talk.

1. "Hi, I'm Macdara, I build websites for local gyms, and I had a look at [Gym name]'s site before I walked in."
2. "Three things stood out: [defect 1, e.g. the class timetable takes four taps on a phone], [defect 2], [defect 3]."
3. "I'd build you a new site from scratch, designed around your gym and your members, and I'd host and look after it so you never touch the technical side."
4. "I can show you what that would look like for [Gym name] before you commit to anything."
5. "Can I leave my card and come back [day] to show you?"

- **Placeholders:** The three defects must come from the gym's real site, checked in a browser before you walk in. I haven't looked at it, so I made nothing up.
- **Hosting:** Sentence 3 names hosting and care because care isn't optional on any tier.
- **Demo:** Sentence 4 promises a demo, so a draft for that gym has to exist before you go. `/prospect-to-pitch` builds it.
- **Sentence 5:** It's the only ask, which suits a first visit. Say if you'd rather end by booking a time on the spot.
